name: Particle
tagline: Cloud platform for fleets of IoT devices with REST, OTA, and remote functions
description: Particle provides a mature IoT device cloud with REST APIs for fleet management, OTA firmware updates, device variables and functions, events, and product/device provisioning. Developers use access tokens to call endpoints for listing devices, reading variables, calling remote functions, publishing events, and managing products at scale.

auth.details: OAuth access token (Bearer or access_token query/form param); create tokens in console or via OAuth. Product APIs also use product-scoped tokens.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Up to 100 devices (cellular or Wi-Fi), 100,000 Data Operations per month pooled across all devices, and up to 100 MB of pooled cellular data per month.

rate_limits: 10,000 requests per 5 minutes per source IP for all API routes; selected token, account, and event routes: 100 per 5 minutes; SSE: 100 simultaneous connections per source IP; serial-number lookup: 50 per hour per access-token user account.
use_cases: list devices in a Particle account or product fleet
read a device cloud variable by name
call a remote function on a connected device
publish or subscribe to Particle device events
trigger or monitor OTA firmware updates for a fleet
